WCD_calculation.arrival_curve_per_flow: For each flow i: alpha_i(t) = sigma_i + rho_i * t, where sigma_i = payload_i (Bytes), rho_i = payload_i / period_i (Bytes/us).

WCD_calculation.per_port_delay_bound: For aggregate arrival at port p with sigma_p = sum_i sigma_i and rho_p = sum_i rho_i over all flows traversing p, the NC delay bound is D_p = T + sigma_p / (R - rho_p). Here T=0, so D_p = sigma_p / (9.375 - rho_p).
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: For flow f with hop_count H (number of links) and S = H - 1 switches: WCD_f = sum_{ports p on f} D_p + H * Prop + S * Switch + S * Sync. Using Prop=1 us/link, Switch=1 us/switch, Sync=1 us/switch, equivalently: WCD_f = sum_p D_p + (3*H - 2) us.

all_parameters_used.arrival_curve_definition: For flow i with period P_i (us) and payload L_i (Bytes): sigma_i = 8*L_i (bits); rho_i = sigma_i / P_i (bits/us); alpha_i(t) = sigma_i + rho_i * t.
all_parameters_used.cbs_service_curve_definition: At each egress port (queue 6, Class A), lower-bounded service curve is rate-latency: beta(t) = R * [t - T0]^+, with R = IdleSlope = 0.75*C and T0 = propagation + switching + time_sync = 3 us (no lower-priority blocking assumed).
all_parameters_used.WCD_equation: Per-port delay bound for aggregate S on port p: D_p = T0 + (Sigma_S) / (R - Rho_S), where Rho_S = sum_k rho_k over flows using port p, Sigma_S = sum_k sigma_k. End-to-end WCD for flow i: WCD_i = sum_{ports p on i's path} D_p.

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve: alpha_i(t) = sigma_i + rho_i * t, where sigma_i = 8 * payload_i (bits), rho_i = sigma_i / period_i (bits/us).
WCD_calculation.CBS_service_curve: beta_p(t) = R * [t - T0]^+ at each egress port p on queue 6 (Class A), where R = IdleSlope = 0.75 * C and T0 = propagation + switching + time_sync = 3 us.
WCD_calculation.per_port_delay_bound: D_p = T0 + (Sigma_S) / (R - Rho_S), with Rho_S = sum of rho over all flows using port p and Sigma_S = sum of sigma over those flows.
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_i = sum over all egress ports p along the path of flow i of D_p.

constants.Queueing_model: Cut-through switches; CBS (IEEE 802.1Qav) only; Class A; PCP=6; queue=6

all_parameters_used.arrival_curve_definition: For each flow i: alpha_i(t) = sigma_i + rho_i * t, where sigma_i = L_i_bits, rho_i = L_i_bits / T_i_us
all_parameters_used.CBS_service_curve_definition: For each egress port p: beta_p(t) = I * [t - T_p]^+, with I = IdleSlope (bits/us), T_p = Lmax_p_bits / I (since T_p = Lmax/C + Lmax*(C - I)/(C*I) = Lmax/I for class-A-only).
all_parameters_used.end_to_end_WCD: WCD(flow) = sum_{ports on path} D_p + initial_prop(1us) + k*(prop 1us + switching 1us + sync_error 1us), where k = number of egress ports along the path.

WCD_calculation.per_flow_arrival_curve: alpha_i(t) = sigma_i + rho_i * t, with sigma_i = 8*payload_bytes, rho_i = sigma_i / period_us
WCD_calculation.per_port_CBS_service_curve: beta_p(t) = I * [t - T_p]^+, I = IdleSlope = 0.75*C = 75 bits/us; T_p = Lmax_p_bits / I (for single-class-A, no lower-priority).
WCD_calculation.fixed_delays: Initial ES->first-switch propagation = 1us. For each egress port (hop): propagation 1us + switching 1us + sync_error 1us = 3us/hop.
WCD_calculation.end_to_end_WCD: WCD(flow) = sum_{ports on path} D_p + 1us + 3us * k, where k = number of egress ports (switch hops) on the flow's path.

missing_inputs: Exact L2 on-the-wire frame size (MAC header, VLAN tag, preamble, SFD, IFG) — assumed payload-only

formulas.arrival_curve: alpha_i(t) = b_i + r_i * t, where b_i = 8 * payload_bytes_i (bits), r_i = b_i / period_i (bits/us)
formulas.CBS_service_curve_per_port: beta_p(t) = I * [ t - T_p ]_+, with I = IdleSlope, T_p = d_sw + d_prop + d_sync + (L_A_max_p / C) * (|S| / I), C = link rate, S = I - C
formulas.leftover_service_per_flow_at_port: beta_i,p(t) = (I - sum_{j in F_p, j != i} r_j) * [ t - T_p ]_+
formulas.per_port_delay_bound: D_i,p = T_p + b_i / (I - sum_{j in F_p \ {i}} r_j)
formulas.end_to_end_WCD: WCD_i = sum_{ports p on path_i} D_i,p

WCD_calculation.method: Network Calculus with CBS (IEEE 802.1Qav) lower-bounded service curve, blind multiplexing leftover service per port, concatenation across hops.
steps: 1) For each flow i: alpha_i(t) = b_i + r_i t, with b_i = 8 * payload_bytes, r_i = b_i / period_us.
2) For each egress port p: Service curve beta_p(t) = I [ t - T_p ]+, where I = IdleSlope, T_p = d_sw + d_prop + d_sync + (L_A_max_p / C) * (|S|/I).
3) Leftover service for flow i on port p: beta_i,p(t) = (I - sum_{j in F_p, j!=i} r_j) [ t - T_p ]+.
4) Per-port delay bound: D_i,p = T_p + b_i / (I - sum_{j in F_p \ {i}} r_j).
5) End-to-end WCD: WCD_i = sum over all egress ports on the given path of D_i,p.
notes: IdleSlope = 0.75 * C = 75 bits/us. SendSlope = IdleSlope - C = -25 bits/us.

Frame size equals given payload (Bytes) without L2 overheads
Per-hop fixed delay includes 1 µs propagation + 1 µs switching + 1 µs sync error

WCD_calculation.equation: For each port j: beta_j(t) = I * [t - T_j]^+, with I = IdleSlope. T_j = L_block/C + L_A_max_j*(1/I - 1/C) + d_fixed. Aggregate arrival alpha_j(t) = sum_k (sigma_k + rho_k t). Worst-case delay at port j: D_j = (Sum_k sigma_k)/I + T_j. End-to-end WCD for flow f: WCD(f) = sum over ports j on f's path of D_j.

CBS_model_and_service_curve.T_i_us_components: T_i = t_prop + t_sw + t_sync + t_block + t_credit
CBS_model_and_service_curve.t_block_us: L_max_port / C (non-preemptive blocking on egress queue)
CBS_model_and_service_curve.t_credit_us: |loCredit| / I, with |loCredit| = (C - I)/C * L_max_port = 0.25 * L_max_port (Bytes), I in B/us

WCD_calculation.arrival_curve: alpha(t) = sigma + rho * t, with sigma = frame_size [Bytes], rho = frame_size / period [B/us]
WCD_calculation.tandem_server: Concatenation of rate-latency servers => beta_e2e(t) = I * max(0, t - sum_i T_i)
WCD_calculation.delay_bound: WCD = sum_i T_i + sigma / (I - rho), for rho < I

all_parameters_used.service_curve_per_port: beta_p(t) = I * [t - T_cbs_p]^+, with T_cbs_p = Lmax_p * (C - I) / (I * C) = Lmax_p/300 us (for C=100, I=75 b/us)

equations: For flow k with payload L_k (bits) and period T_k (us): alpha_k(t) = b_k + r_k * t, where b_k = L_k and r_k = L_k / T_k (bits/us).
For each egress port p (queue 6 only): beta_p(t) = I * [t - T_cbs_p]^+, with I = 0.75*C and T_cbs_p = Lmax_p * (C - I) / (I*C). With C=100 and I=75 (bits/us), T_cbs_p = Lmax_p / 300 (us).
Aggregate burst at port p: b_tot_p = sum_{j in F_p} L_j (bits), where F_p is the set of flows traversing port p.
Per-port CBS queuing bound (FIFO, all Class-A): D_queue_p = (b_tot_p / I) + T_cbs_p.
Fixed delays per flow: D_fixed = hop_count * t_prop + (hop_count - 1) * t_sw + t_sync. With t_prop = t_sw = t_sync = 1 us, D_fixed = 2*hop_count (us).
End-to-end WCD for flow f: D_f = sum_{p in ports_on_path(f)} D_queue_p + D_fixed.
assumptions: All Class-A flows only (queue 6), no higher/lower-priority interference (worst-case lower-priority blocking assumed 0).
Frame size equals given payload (no L2 overhead added).
FIFO within the Class-A queue; CBS parameters identical on all egress ports.
Stability holds: sum of rates of flows at each port << IdleSlope.

missing_inputs: Maximum size and presence of lower-priority interfering frames (would increase T_cbs via positive credit and add one-frame blocking).
Exact L2 frame size (headers, VLAN tag, FCS, preamble/IFG) to compute serialization precisely.
Whether end-stations also employ CBS shaping and their exact parameters; analysis applies CBS at bridge egresses only.
Any per-port gate control list (802.1Qbv) or preemption (802.1Qbu) is disallowed/unspecified; assumed absent as required.
